name: ecomedu
description: EcomEdu - e-commerce learning platform (public portal, admin, teacher, backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,public,admin,teacher -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w public" "npm run dev -w admin" "npm run dev -w teacher"
scripts.build: npm run build -w public && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w teacher
